note: Wave D lane twt_exec (lanes/twt/execute.rs + auto.rs, ported from app/twt_execute.py and app/twt_auto.py): the confirm path end to end in DRY_RUN on the bed's real tw_ rows. Graded here: SELL_AT_OPEN (partial and full, MA-trail and manual, not-in-book refusals) on EVENING plans 72, 83 and 87; RAISE_GTT_STOP on plan 72; the refusals before any read (422 on a missing/garbled field, 400 without confirm=true, 404 unknown plan/line or a line of another plan, 405); 409 on a second confirm; both sides of plan 72's expiry at 21:50:00.207377 IST (410 is checked before the line's state); SESSION_CAP on plan 22 (28 Sep already holds five sent buys); BUY_AT_OPEN refused PROTECTION_UNRESOLVED (plans 72 and 25: the bed carries twelve open twt lv_protection_issue rows); rearm, the 15:15 sweep and reconcile. Wave D2 adds the BUY PATH section at the end: the twt lv_protection_issue rows resolved as the LV reconciler would resolve them, and a seeded MORNING plan 9001 for 30 Oct (five BUY_AT_OPEN lines with their tw_signal_daily turnover rows, one ARM_GTT line), so a buy reaches the gateway: the re-size against the live quote and against the plan's preview, the turnover-cap refusal, place (DRY_RUN), apply_fill, the GTT stop armed in the same request (non-negotiable 4), client_id = plan_id:symbol and the gateway's own idempotency on a re-posted line, the three-entries-a-session cap on the fourth buy, and the ARM_GTT kind on a position whose stop was cancelled by hand. First-ten half size is a live-money rule (DRY_RUN never moves the countdown) and is pinned by the unit tests. The replay Kite must record no order or GTT call. db_mask: server-stamped now() columns only (risk_ledger.updated_at, tw_fill.created_at, tw_session/tw_plan_line/tw_position created_at/updated_at, tw_order.updated_at, tw_plan.created_at, tw_signal_daily.created_at) — the injected clock cannot reach the database.
